source: Packaged runtime dependency inventory for vault-facing skills.

deferredChecks: Resolver symlink-target containment qualification is deferred to the vault owner, not a readiness, authoring, or release gate. Owners may intentionally configure external targets. PowerShell filesystem containment remains mandatory.
knownLimitations: Resolver 2.1.0 can follow file symlinks outside an authorized root when reading heading or block targets.
This repository has not verified upstream symlink-target containment; do not describe an exact-root match as proof that all Resolver reads stay inside the vault.
